content.description: Liquid staking protocol on the Aptos network. Operating at the forefront of the DeFi Dapps sector, Amnis redefines how users interact with liquid staking platforms. The protocol leverages the advanced capabilities of Aptos to provide a seamless, non-custodial experience that guarantees user sovereignty. Its architecture is explicitly built for scale, accommodating high throughput and complex decentralized operations. With a strong commitment to open-source principles, Amnis stands out as a crucial utility in the modern Web3 tech stack.
